compiler_policy.build: Original compiler, flags, sources and binary identities remain immutable provenance. No compilation or replacement binary is permitted.
compiler_policy.execution: Record g++ path/version/SHA-256 if installed, otherwise record its absence. It need not match the build compiler. A present but unreadable or unidentifiable compiler blocks inspection.
compiler_policy.after_freeze: The actual execution compiler identity, including presence/absence, joins exact runtime/software identity comparison. Any change stops before further worker calls. Do not update the frozen record to accept drift.

timing_host_policy.wsl: Inspection only. This revision cannot establish a fixed physical-core mapping for WSL virtual CPUs; host preparation and collection are blocked. No override flag is provided.
timing_host_policy.physical_placement: Before preparing a host record, document the selected Linux CPU's physical host/core identity and core type, mapping evidence, sibling-load and power/thermal controls. A dedicated VM additionally requires host-side pinning and non-migration evidence. Operator evidence must be reviewed and published before collection; guest affinity alone is insufficient.
timing_host_policy.same_environment: Retain exact machine, topology, selected CPU, kernel, libraries, interpreter, source and runtime environment across batches; stop on identity change. No heterogeneous timing normalization.

unchanged: four solver configurations and branching policy
